#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Emits a divider glyph only when the given monitor's active workspace has
# open windows, so the divider disappears entirely (no reserved space)
# alongside the native workspace-taskbar icons when the workspace is empty.
set -euo pipefail
MONITOR="${1:-$WAYBAR_OUTPUT_NAME}"

emit() {
  local ws count
  ws=$(hyprctl -j monitors | jq -r --arg m "$MONITOR" '.[] | select(.name == $m) | .activeWorkspace.id')
  count=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --argjson ws "${ws:-0}" '[ .[] | select(.workspace.id == $ws) ] | length')
  if [ "${count:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    jq -nc '{text: "│"}'
  else
    jq -nc '{text: ""}'
  fi
}

emit

socat -U - "UNIX-CONNECT:$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr/$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE/.socket2.sock" | \
while read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    openwindow*|closewindow*|movewindow*|workspace*|activewindow*|focusedmon*)
      emit
      ;;
  esac
done

input.command: hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | "\(.workspace.id)\t\(.class)\t\(.title[0:40])\tmapped=\(.mapped)\thidden=\(.hidden)\tfloating=\(.floating)\txwayland=\(.xwayland)\tsize=\(.size|join("x"))"' | sort -n

input.command: waybar --version; echo "=== which waybar ==="; which waybar; echo "=== pacman/dpkg ==="; (pacman -Qi waybar 2>/dev/null | head -5) || (dpkg -s waybar 2>/dev/null | head -5)

waybar-hyprland-workspaces(5) File Formats Manualwaybar-hyprland-workspaces(5)

NAME
       waybar - hyprland workspaces module

DESCRIPTION
       The  workspaces	module displays the currently used workspaces in hypr‐
       land compositor.

CONFIGURATION
       Addressed by hyprland/workspaces

       format:
	    typeof: string
	    default: {id}
	    The format, how information should be displayed.

       format-icons:
	    typeof: array
	    Based on the workspace ID and state, the corresponding  icon  gets
       selected. See icons.

       window-rewrite:
	    typeof: object
	    Regex  rules to map window class to an icon or preferred method of
       representation for a workspace's window.
	   Keys are the rules, while the values are the methods of representa‐

=== workspace rules (waybar reads these for persistent workspaces) ===
[{
    "workspaceString": "3",
    "persistent": true
}]

=== keybinds: workspace toggle binds ===
5:--    SUPER            = window & workspace management
16:--  movetoworkspacesilent, togglesplit, pin, centerwindow). exec_raw
51:hl.bind(modKey .. " + D", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" })) -- toggle float
52:hl.bind(modKey .. " + J", hl.dsp.exec_raw("togglesplit"))            -- flip split axis
55:-- (0.55 quirk: fullscreen toggle-off can misfire from a bind; works via hyprctl)
65:-- Toggle whole-workspace layout dwindle <-> master  (Omarchy's SUPER+L)
96:--  WORKSPACES  (SUPER = go, +SHIFT = move, +SHIFT+ALT = silent)
99:    hl.bind(modKey .. " + " .. i, hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = i }))
100:    hl.bind(modKey .. " + SHIFT + " .. i, hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = i }))
101:    hl.bind(modKey .. " + SHIFT + ALT + " .. i, hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = i, silent = true }))
104:-- 0 key = workspace 10 
105:hl.bind(modKey .. " + 0", hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = 10 }))
106:hl.bind(modKey .. " + ALT + 0", hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = 10 }))
107:hl.bind(modKey .. " + SHIFT + ALT + 0", hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = 10, silent = true }))
109:hl.bind(modKey .. " + S",       hl.dsp.workspace.toggle_special("scratchpad"))
110:hl.bind(modKey .. " + ALT + S", hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "special:scratchpad" }))
120:hl.bind(modKey .. " + CTRL + I", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("pkill hypridle || hypridle"))   -- toggle idle
125:hl.bind(modKey .. " + SHIFT + SPACE", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("pkill -SIGUSR1 waybar"))   -- toggle bar
139:hl.bind("XF86AudioMute",        hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle"),       { locked = true })
140:hl.bind("XF86AudioMicMute",     hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ toggle"),     { locked = true })

		    Enables the workspace taskbar mode.

		    Format  to	use  for each window in the workspace taskbar.

	       icon-size:
		    typeof: int
		    default: 16
		    Size of the icons in the workspace taskbar.

	       icon-theme:
		    typeof: string | array
		    default: []
		    Icon theme to use for the workspace taskbar. If  an	 array

	       default icon theme is used.

	       orientation:
		    typeof: "horizontal" | "vertical"
		    default: horizontal
		    Direction in which the workspace taskbar is displayed.

       show-special:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If set to true, special workspaces will be shown.

       special-visible-only:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If this and show-special are to true, special workspaces  will  be
       shown only if visible.

       persistent-only:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If set to true, only persistent workspaces will be shown on bar.

       all-outputs:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If	set  to	 false workspaces group will be shown only in assigned
       output. Otherwise, all workspace groups are shown.

       active-only:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If set to true, only the active workspace will be shown.

       move-to-monitor:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false
	    If set to true, open the workspace on  the	current	 monitor  when
       clicking on a workspace button.
	   Otherwise, the workspace will open on the monitor where it was pre‐
	   viously  assigned. Analog to using `focusworkspaceoncurrentmonitor`
	   dispatcher instead of `workspace` in Hyprland.

       ignore-workspaces:
	    typeof: array
	    default: []
	    Regexes to match against workspaces names. If there's a match, the
       workspace will not be shown. This takes precedence  over	 show-special,
       all-outputs, and active-only.

       sort-by:
	    typeof: string
	    default: "default"
	    If set to number, workspaces will sort by number.
	   If  set  to name, workspaces will sort by name. If set to id, work‐
	   spaces will sort by id. If set to special-centered, workspaces will
	   sort by default with special workspaces in the center. If  none  of
	   those, workspaces will sort with default behavior.

       expand:
	    typeof: bool
	    default: false

# Analysis of waybar Hyprland Workspaces Module

## 1) Usage of `active-only` (m_activeOnly)

The provided source code **does not contain any implementation using `m_activeOnly`**. The member variable is declared and populated via `populateBoolConfig(config, "active-only", m_activeOnly)` in the `parseConfig()` method, but no logic references it to show/hide workspace buttons. The visibility logic in `updateWorkspaceStates()` sets visibility based on `getVisibleWorkspaces()` only, which queries monitors for active/special workspaces—not tied to `m_activeOnly`.

## 2) Persistent Workspaces Creation and active-only Exemption

Persistent workspaces are created through two paths:

- **From config:** `loadPersistentWorkspacesFromConfig()` reads `m_persistentWorkspaceConfig` and marks workspaces with `workspaceData["persistent-config"] = true`
- **From Hyprland rules:** `loadPersistentWorkspacesFromWorkspaceRules()` queries "workspacerules" and marks with `workspaceData["persistent-rule"] = true`

Both feed into `m_workspacesToCreate`. Removal is gated by: `"if ((*workspace)->isPersistentConfig()) { ... return; }"` in `removeWorkspace()`, preventing deletion of config-persistent workspaces only. There is **no exemption logic for `m_activeOnly`** since it is unused.

## 3) Workspace-Taskbar Window Map Building

The source provides **no direct window map construction code**. Windows are queued in `m_windowsToCreate` via `onWindowOpened()`, then `updateWindowsToCreate()` calls `workspace->onWindowOpened(windowPayload)` (implementation not shown). Active window status is set: `"bool isActive = m_currentActiveWindowAddress == windowAddress;"` before queuing—the window is not added to a different workspace.

## 4) Active Window Event Handling

The `onActiveWindowChanged()` method receives the active window address and:

> "for (auto &[address, window] : m_orphanWindowMap) { window.setActive(address == activeWindowAddress); } for (auto const &workspace : m_workspaces) { workspace->setActiveWindow(activeWindowAddress); } for (auto &window : m_windowsToCreate) { window.setActive(window.getAddress() == activeWindowAddress); }"

This marks windows as active across orphans, workspaces, and the creation queue—it does not reassign windows between workspaces.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Emits waybar JSON selecting a pikachu sprite via CSS class. The sprite itself
# lives in style.css as a background-image on #custom-battery-icon.<class>.
set -euo pipefail

BATTERY_SYSFS="${BATTERY_SYSFS:-/sys/class/power_supply/BAT0/capacity}"

log() {
  printf '[%s] pickachu-battery: %s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$*" >&2
}

# A single space, not an empty string: waybar hides a custom module whose text
# is empty, and the space is what the background image paints behind.
emit() {
  printf '{"text":"%s","class":"%s"}\n' "$1" "$2"
}

capacity="${WAYBAR_BATTERY_CAPACITY:-}"

if [ -z "$capacity" ]; then
  if [ ! -r "$BATTERY_SYSFS" ]; then
    log "cannot read $BATTERY_SYSFS; hiding module"
    emit "" ""
    exit 0
  fi
  capacity=$(<"$BATTERY_SYSFS")
fi

if ! [[ "$capacity" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  log "non-numeric capacity '$capacity'; hiding module"
  emit "" ""
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$capacity" -gt 80 ]; then
  class=p100
elif [ "$capacity" -gt 60 ]; then
  class=p80
elif [ "$capacity" -gt 40 ]; then
  class=p60
elif [ "$capacity" -gt 20 ]; then
  class=p40
elif [ "$capacity" -gt 10 ]; then
  class=p20
else
  class=p10
fi

log "capacity=$capacity class=$class"
emit " " "$class"
